description: Create or replace bills of materials by finished-good SKU (max 500 per call) — the manufacturing seeding path. Each row is one finished good plus its COMPLETE component list (component SKU + quantity per unit, optional UoM/note/scrap); an existing BOM's components are replaced by the list, so resubmitting is safe (the upsert converges). The finished good and every component must already exist as items in the credential's namespace — nothing is auto-created; use upsert_items first (labor/overhead lines are items too, typically type=noninventory). Created BOMs are flagged primary so planning explodes them. Set validateOnly=true first to get every row's would_create/would_replace/invalid verdict without writing, then re-call without it to apply. Partial success: valid rows land even when siblings fail, with per-row errors naming the unresolved SKUs. A row reported partially_applied was written but didn't finish cleanly — re-send it to converge. Operator (unpinned) credentials on 3PL tenants pass clientId to resolve SKUs within that client's namespace.

boms.description: BOM rows (max 500). finishedGoodSku and a non-empty components list are required per row.

scrapPercentage.description: Optional expected scrap/waste as a PERCENTAGE from 0 to 100: 5 means 5% extra material (send 5, not 0.05). Planning and production consumption use quantity × (1 + scrapPercentage / 100). Default 0.

clientId.description: Optional client id (GUID) for operator (unpinned) credentials on 3PL tenants: resolves finished-good/component SKUs within that client's namespace — get ids from list_clients. Client-pinned credentials omit this; the credential decides.

validateOnly.description: true = dry-run: validate + probe every row and report would_create/would_replace per row, writing nothing. Recommended before the first real call.
